subject.label: sport
subject._note: School of Sport container context: a single academic school spanning sport & exercise science (physiology, biomechanics, sport psychology, nutrition), sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, and strength & conditioning. No QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge.

_note: School of Sport container context pack for revising-exams-intermediate. The subject is the School of Sport as a whole, not a single discipline, so worked examples draw on different sport subjects and vary lesson to lesson: L01 sport & exercise science, L02 sport coaching and physical education, L03 sport therapy and rehabilitation. Keeps the Tom (weaker) / Amara (stronger) cast as School of Sport students. Mirrors the psychology pack's page set and per-page slot structure.
